title: Acceptance value of a sign tester
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized sign tester with a finite seed space and a probability law on that space, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. Its acceptance probability is the expected randomized value of the check selected by the sampled seed, evaluated on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: probability law on the seed space
each seed selects a sign query check
$f$ takes values in $[-1,1]$ on the sign cube
